triggers.detailsText: The details of any change in the status and/ or any development in relation to such proceedings On 24.08.2020, the Department of Telecommunications ("DoT") issued a demand notice for INR 8.56 Crores against Sterlite Technologies Limited (“the Company”) alleging violation of the terms of its IP-I Registration. DoT challenged the said Arbitral Award under Section 34 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 before the Hon'ble High Court of Delhi. The Hon’ble Court dismissed the said petition, thereby upholding the Arbitral Award in the Company’s favour with zero financial or operational exposure.

The Hon’ble Court dismissed the said petition, thereby upholding the Arbitral Award in the Company’s favour with zero financial or operational exposure.

(IST).

triggers.detailsText: Indian Card Clothing Company Limited has informed the Exchange about change in Management - we would like to inform you that Mr. Sanjeevkumar Karkamkar, Executive Director & Chief Financial Officer ( CFO ) [Whole-time Key Managerial Personnel ( KMP )] of theCompany, has resigned from the position of Executive Director & CFO effective from September1, 2026.
